p_documentation: Edit the language JSON and templates in `.readme/` and `.changelog/`, then regenerate the documents. Do not edit generated Markdown directly. The root README uses Simplified Chinese. These commands require Python 3.10 or newer without extra Python packages; Windows can use `py` instead of `python`. `--check` validates languages, fields, historical versions and dates, punctuation, and generated files without writing. CI runs the same check.
p_baseline: [AutoJs4]({{ app_url }}) is the behavioral baseline of [AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com): apart from a few specific cases, scripts that run correctly on AutoJs4 should produce exactly the same effects and results on AutoJs6.
p_docs_relation: [AutoJs4-Documentation]({{ docs_url }}) preserves the applicable open-source Auto.js `4.1.0` documentation and serves as the reference baseline of [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com). The application version `4.1.1 Alpha2` and documentation version `4.1.0` are distinct labels.
p_runtime: [AutoJs6-Plugin-AutoJs4-Runtime]({{ runtime_url }}) embeds the AutoJs4 engine modules `autojs`, `common`, and `automator` through a Git submodule and runs scripts in a separate process. "Run with AutoJs4" in the AutoJs6 file manager enables result comparisons without installing AutoJs4 separately.
p_docs_intro: This repository maintains reference documentation for AutoJs4, cloned from hyb1996's AutoJs-Docs project. The original documentation project first appeared on `2017/08/21`; this repository uses the open-source Auto.js `4.1.0` documentation released by the original author on `2018/12/21` as its verification baseline.
p_docs_policy: The structure and applicable content of the open-source documentation are preserved, with Pro-only interfaces and descriptions removed and relevant corrections and supplements retained. The repository introduction and maintenance history are available in 10 languages; historical API text keeps its existing language.
p_docs_reference: Content is checked against historical documentation commit [0daee2a]({{ historical_docs_url }}) and the [original source preserved by AutoJs4]({{ app_original_source_url }}). The original repository is unavailable, so the historical link uses a mirror retaining the original commit. Additional Canvas/UI interfaces were verified against the original source; Pro interfaces, Pro module-alias examples using `$`, and inapplicable Node.js `util` references have been removed.
p_reading: [Read AutoJs4 documentation online]({{ docs_site_url }}) / [Markdown documentation sources]({{ docs_url }}/tree/main/api) / [Preserved HTML documentation]({{ docs_url }}/tree/main/docs).
p_docs_links: [AutoJs4 application repository]({{ app_url }}) / [Report a documentation issue]({{ docs_url }}/issues).
p_other_projects: [AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com) continues development from Auto.js. [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com) supplies the shared content source for its [online documentation](https://docs.autojs6.com) and offline documentation plugin.
p_archive: The [original AutoJs-Docs repository introduction]({{ original_readme_url }}) retains the exact bytes of the first import and is not translated. The [original Auto.js 4.1.0 documentation]({{ historical_docs_url }}) is pinned to a historical commit, separate from this repository's subsequently corrected content. Historical links in the original introduction are unchanged.
